hunks.baseline: The grandeur of the enormous library that unfolded before us when the doors opened was astonishing enough, but the doors themselves had opened without any human hand or movement of internal energy.
hunks.sol: The enormous library revealed when the doors opened was impressive enough, but so was the fact that they had opened without anyone touching them or using internal energy.

hunks.baseline: And as someone who had spent his entire modern life passing through automatic doors tens of thousands of times, I still found it a remarkably fresh experience.
hunks.sol: Even to someone who had spent his entire modern life passing through automatic doors tens of thousands of times, it was a remarkably novel experience.

hunks.baseline: The doors that had just opened contained components made of iron and wood, all intricately interwoven into an elaborate structure.
hunks.sol: The doors contained an intricate arrangement of iron and wooden components, all precisely interlocked.

hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t all. As I slowly turned my head and looked around the library, I saw unmistakable traces of mechanisms like the one installed in the doors everywhere.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all. As I slowly looked around the library, I saw unmistakable traces of similar mechanisms throughout the place.

hunks.baseline: Of course, compared to the cutting edge of modern civilization, they were crude. But there was no question that this was a sight I had never encountered in any of the other prestigious great families and sects I had visited.
hunks.sol: Of course, they were crude compared to the cutting edge of modern civilization. But I had certainly never seen anything like them in any of the other prestigious great families or sects I’d visited.

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Gyun shouted loudly while everyone, myself included, stared around.
hunks.sol: As everyone, myself included, stared around, Zhuge Gyun shouted.

hunks.baseline: His shout, infused with internal energy, echoed through the library.
hunks.sol: His voice, infused with internal energy, echoed through the library.

hunks.baseline: The space was not merely large. Vast was the more appropriate word. It was larger than a modern soccer stadium.
hunks.sol: The space wasn’t merely large. Vast was the only word for it. It was bigger than a modern soccer stadium.

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Gyun’s voice burrowed between the endless rows of bookshelves, but no answer came back.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Gyun’s shout carried between the endless rows of bookshelves, but no answer came.

hunks.baseline: “He seems to be inside, but… Ah, this is driving me crazy.”
hunks.sol: “He seems to be somewhere inside, but… Ah, this is driving me crazy.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had been looking around the library, interrupted him.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had been looking around the library, cut him off.

hunks.baseline: “He’ll come out when the time is right. Everyone has their own circumstances.”
hunks.sol: “He’ll come out when the time is right. He must have his reasons.”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung even dropped the candied fruit he had been bringing to his mouth.
hunks.sol: Even Cheongpung dropped the candied fruit he had been bringing to his mouth.

hunks.baseline: I was still seriously considering the question when Jeok Cheongang continued with a warm smile.
hunks.sol: I was seriously considering the question when Jeok Cheongang continued with a warm smile.

hunks.baseline: “Come to think of it, this old man has never seen a library so large and magnificent in his entire life. Would it be all right if I looked around for a while?”
hunks.sol: “Come to think of it, this old man has never seen such a large and magnificent library in his life. Would it be all right if I looked around for a while?”

hunks.baseline: “It was a joke, you little punk. Ho-ho. Even so, how could I burn everything down indiscriminately when I’m here as a guest?”
hunks.sol: “It was a joke, you little punk. Ho-ho. How could I burn everything in sight when I’m here as a guest?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang laughed heartily before continuing.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang laughed heartily, then added,

hunks.baseline: “Unless I accidentally knock over a bookshelf.”
hunks.sol: “Knocking over a bookshelf by accident would be another matter.”

hunks.baseline: And in the next moment, Jeok Cheongang’s body shot upward like a streak of light.
hunks.sol: In the next instant, Jeok Cheongang shot upward like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, his palm strike, carrying the tremendous force of ten thousand geun, slammed into the nearest bookshelf.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a palm strike carrying the tremendous force of ten thousand geun slammed into the nearest bookshelf.

hunks.baseline: It happened before anyone had time to stop him. I stared at the scene unfolding before me with my mouth hanging open.
hunks.sol: It happened before anyone could stop him. I stared at the scene unfolding before me, my mouth hanging open.

hunks.baseline: The countless bookshelves packed together at regular intervals transformed into one enormous domino in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: In the blink of an eye, the countless shelves packed together at regular intervals became one enormous row of dominoes.

hunks.baseline: An earth-shaking roar swallowed Zhuge Gyun’s scream.
hunks.sol: The deafening roar swallowed Zhuge Gyun’s scream.

hunks.baseline: As every bookshelf collapsed, dust that had accumulated over many years burst into the air all at once and filled the library in a dense cloud.
hunks.sol: As every bookshelf came crashing down, years of accumulated dust erupted into the air and filled the library in a dense cloud.

hunks.baseline: No, I wasn’t even sure it could still be called a library. A graveyard of books. Something like that would have been more appropriate.
hunks.sol: No, I wasn’t even sure it could still be called a library. A graveyard of books would have been more appropriate.

hunks.baseline: It might even have become one person’s grave.
hunks.sol: It might even have become one man’s grave.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang patted Zhuge Gyun on the shoulder as he wailed.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang patted the wailing Zhuge Gyun on the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: After smacking Zhuge Gyun on the back of the head, Jeok Cheongang opened his mouth with an incredulous expression.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang smacked him on the back of the head and gave him an incredulous look.

hunks.baseline: “You really don’t understand jokes, do you? Can’t you see your father over there, alive and well?”
hunks.sol: “You really can’t take a joke, can you? Can’t you see your father over there, alive and well?”

hunks.baseline: After a couple of coughs came from within the thick cloud of dust, a slender figure emerged, waving one hand as he walked forward.
hunks.sol: A couple of coughs came from within the thick cloud of dust, and a slender figure emerged, waving one hand as he walked toward us.

hunks.baseline: “Well, now. Cough. I’m sorry I couldn’t come out to greet you in advance. There have been an unusual number of matters requiring my attention lately. Cough.”
hunks.sol: “Well, now. Cough. I’m sorry I couldn’t come out to greet you sooner. There have been an unusual number of matters requiring my attention lately. Cough.”

hunks.baseline: With the sound of compressed air bursting outward, the dust cloud scattered. At last, the figure of a man became fully visible.
hunks.sol: Compressed air burst outward, scattering the dust cloud. At last, the man came fully into view.

hunks.baseline: “Ha. Seeing you like this, I realize how much time has passed. Do you remember this old man?”
hunks.sol: “Ha. Seeing you like this makes me realize how much time has passed. Do you remember this old man?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. That day was the fifth Mid-Autumn Festival I celebrated after being born. Senior ate two plates of roast duck and five jars of Yeoahong, then fought a duel with Great Hero Peng as the gathering was ending and ended up with a bloody nose.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. It was the fifth Mid-Autumn Festival after my birth. Senior ate two plates of roast duck and drank five jars of Yeoahong, then fought a duel with Great Hero Peng as the gathering drew to a close and ended up with a bloody nose.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Great Hero Peng laughed loudly and struck the table, spilling wine onto Senior’s knee. It was a minor disagreement.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Great Hero Peng laughed loudly and struck the table, spilling wine on Senior’s knee. It was a minor disagreement.”

hunks.baseline: “A major incident in which it wouldn’t have been strange for someone to die.”
hunks.sol: “That sounds like a major incident where it wouldn’t have been strange for someone to die.”

hunks.baseline: “Quite a few years have passed, but that incredible head of yours is still as sharp as ever. All right, enough nonsense. Come here. You have guests waiting for you.”
hunks.sol: “Quite a few years have passed, but that remarkable memory of yours hasn’t changed. All right, enough nonsense. Come here. You have guests waiting for you.”

hunks.baseline: “I was planning to greet them regardless.”
hunks.sol: “I was just about to greet them.”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man had been covered in dust, but it couldn’t conceal his refined appearance.
hunks.sol: Though the middle-aged man was covered in dust, it couldn’t conceal his refined appearance.

hunks.baseline: He was the youngest Sect Leader of any prestigious great family or sect I had met so far. His eyes, unusually clear and radiant, turned toward us.
hunks.sol: Of all the leaders of prestigious great families and sects I had met, he was the youngest. His unusually clear, bright eyes turned toward us.

hunks.baseline: “I apologize for keeping such honored guests waiting. I am Zhuge Feng.”
hunks.sol: “My apologies for keeping such honored guests waiting. I am Zhuge Feng.”

hunks.baseline: And the moment I heard what Zhuge Feng said next, before anyone had a chance to respond, I suddenly understood why his sobriquet was Crouching Dragon Guest.
hunks.sol: Then, before anyone could respond, Zhuge Feng continued. The moment I heard his next words, I suddenly understood why his sobriquet was Crouching Dragon Guest.

hunks.baseline: “Time is as valuable as gold, and I have no intention of taking anyone else’s precious gold. Those who wish to remain here may do so. Oh, and it has long been my personal belief that conversations should be held comfortably, so please do not misunderstand.”
hunks.sol: “Time is as precious as gold, and I have no desire to take anyone else’s gold. Only those who wish to remain need stay. Oh, and I’ve always believed people should make themselves comfortable when they talk, so please don’t take this the wrong way.”

hunks.baseline: I wondered what he meant until I saw Zhuge Feng lie down flat on his side right there, paying no attention to the dust piled across the floor. I let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: I wondered what he meant until Zhuge Feng promptly flopped onto his side, paying no attention to the dust coating the floor. A laugh escaped me.

hunks.baseline: As I spoke, I lay down at an angle and propped my chin on one hand. The corners of his eyes curved like crescent moons.
hunks.sol: I lay down at an angle and propped my chin on one hand. The corners of his eyes curved like crescent moons.

hunks.baseline: Although they were dumbfounded, everyone gradually sat down and listened to Zhuge Feng.
hunks.sol: Though everyone looked dumbfounded, they sat down one by one and listened to Zhuge Feng.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song tried to leave, saying that he had to go to a Yangtze River Channel League stronghold in Hubei, but he had no choice but to stop after Zhuge Feng said one thing.
hunks.sol: Mu Song tried to leave, saying he had to visit a Yangtze River Channel League stronghold in Hubei, but one remark from Zhuge Feng stopped him in his tracks.

hunks.baseline: “I won’t stop you if you wish to leave, but what I am about to say is deeply connected to you as well, Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song.”
hunks.sol: “I won’t stop you if you wish to leave, but what I am about to say concerns you deeply as well, Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song.”

hunks.baseline: Mu Song hesitated before remaining behind. Mungyeong, who had seemed the most likely to leave first, unexpectedly stayed quietly in his place.
hunks.sol: Mu Song hesitated, then remained behind. Surprisingly, Mungyeong, who had seemed the most likely to leave first, stayed quietly where he was.

hunks.baseline: Then again, in a situation where everyone else was staying, perhaps leaving alone would have drawn even more attention.
hunks.sol: Then again, with everyone else remaining, leaving alone might have drawn even more attention.

hunks.baseline: Through the Zhuge Clan’s own intelligence network, Zhuge Feng already knew that this young medical apprentice was the Disciple of the Divine Physician. He looked at Mungyeong once with a strange expression, then turned his gaze away and opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: The Zhuge Clan’s intelligence network had already informed Zhuge Feng that this young medical apprentice was the Divine Physician’s Disciple. He gave Mungyeong a curious look, but soon turned away and began to speak.

hunks.baseline: The Nine Sects and One Gang and the Five Great Families were the leading powers representing each province.
hunks.sol: The Nine Sects and One Gang and the Five Great Families were the leading powers of their respective provinces.

hunks.baseline: Since their roots stretched back anywhere from a hundred years to several centuries, each possessed a dense intelligence network that let them know their territory as well as the palm of their hand.
hunks.sol: With roots stretching back anywhere from a hundred years to several centuries, each possessed a dense intelligence network that allowed them to know their territory like the palm of their hand.

hunks.baseline: “The news was that the Sea Serpent Society had disappeared.”
hunks.sol: “The Sea Serpent Society had disappeared.”

hunks.baseline: Unlike the bewildered Cheongpung and me, everyone else opened their eyes wide.
hunks.sol: Unlike the bewildered Cheongpung and me, everyone else’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song’s reaction in particular stood out more than anyone else’s.
hunks.sol: Mu Song’s reaction stood out more than anyone else’s.

hunks.baseline: “Yes, the very one you know. The association formed by the countless fishermen and boatmen living in Hubei Province.”
hunks.sol: “Yes, the very one you know. The association formed by the countless fishermen and boatmen of Hubei Province.”

hunks.baseline: And this news was unquestionably good news, at least for Mu Song. The faint smile that appeared at the corners of his mouth was proof enough.
hunks.sol: And this was unquestionably good news, at least for Mu Song. The faint smile tugging at the corners of his mouth was proof enough.

hunks.baseline: “I cannot say what the Zhuge Clan’s position on this is, but as someone devoted to the League, I find it welcome news. The Sea Serpent Society caused my Master no end of trouble.”
hunks.sol: “I cannot say what the Zhuge Clan thinks of this, but as someone devoted to the League, I welcome the news. The Sea Serpent Society caused my Master no end of trouble.”

hunks.baseline: “I thought you would feel that way. At least in Hubei Province, it was the only organization capable of standing against the Yangtze River Channel League.”
hunks.sol: “I thought you would feel that way. At least within Hubei Province, it was the only organization capable of standing against the Yangtze River Channel League.”

hunks.baseline: No matter how powerful the Yangtze River Channel League was, the number of people engaged in fishing must have been overwhelming.
hunks.sol: No matter how powerful the Yangtze River Channel League was, it must have been vastly outnumbered by the people who made their living from fishing.

hunks.baseline: Although the matter did not concern Sichuan, which was under his responsibility, Mu Song laughed heartily at the news that one powerful rival had disappeared.
hunks.sol: Though Hubei was outside the Sichuan territory under his responsibility, Mu Song laughed heartily at the news that one powerful rival had disappeared.

hunks.baseline: “But how did they end up disbanding? Did they happen to smuggle salt or something…?”
hunks.sol: “But how did they end up disbanding? Were they caught smuggling salt or something…?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course not. Even if they had, the Sea Serpent Society would not have handled the matter so carelessly. If they had been caught, the fleet acting under the Son of Heaven’s command would already have filled the Yangtze in Hubei.”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. Even if they had been smuggling salt, the Sea Serpent Society would never have handled it so carelessly. And if they had been caught, a fleet dispatched by order of the Son of Heaven would already be filling the Yangtze throughout Hubei.”

hunks.baseline: “I get the feeling you have not properly understood what I said.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t think you properly understood what I said.”

hunks.baseline: A pair of clear, transparent eyes fixed on Mu Song.
hunks.sol: His clear, transparent eyes fixed on Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: As he faced Mu Song’s confusion, Zhuge Feng continued slowly.
hunks.sol: As Mu Song stared back in confusion, Zhuge Feng continued slowly.

hunks.baseline: “The Sea Serpent Society disappeared. I mean that someone thoroughly crushed it.”
hunks.sol: “The Sea Serpent Society disappeared. Someone crushed it utterly.”

hunks.baseline: “The night before I received that report, a banquet was held to celebrate the Society Head’s eightieth birthday. Forty-five shipowners who had sworn loyalty to him and roughly a thousand members of the Sea Serpent Society attended. They drank until past midnight and launched dozens of pleasure boats onto the waters of Red Cliffs. And that was the last of it.”
hunks.sol: “The night before I received the report, a banquet was held to celebrate the Society Head’s eightieth birthday. Forty-five shipowners who had sworn loyalty to him and nearly a thousand members of the Sea Serpent Society attended. They drank until past midnight and launched dozens of pleasure boats onto the waters of Red Cliffs. That was the last anyone saw of them.”

hunks.baseline: The next morning, an old boatman who rose at dawn saw countless corpses filling the waters of Red Cliffs and the wreckage of brutally shattered boats.
hunks.sol: The next morning, an old boatman who rose at dawn found the waters of Red Cliffs choked with corpses and the wreckage of brutally shattered boats.

hunks.baseline: The Society Head—the head and body of the Sea Serpent Society—along with dozens of ship owners and the organization’s core members had all met their deaths at Red Cliffs.
hunks.sol: The Society Head and the organization’s core members, including dozens of shipowners, had all met their deaths at Red Cliffs. The Sea Serpent Society had lost both its head and its body.

hunks.baseline: Nothing can move without a head and a body.
hunks.sol: Nothing can move without either.

hunks.baseline: The Sea Serpent Society, which had wielded power in Hubei Province alongside the Yangtze River Channel League for decades, disappeared just like that.
hunks.sol: The Sea Serpent Society, which had stood shoulder to shoulder with the Yangtze River Channel League and wielded power throughout Hubei Province for decades, disappeared just like that.

hunks.baseline: “It is strange that you, of all people, did not know about it.”
hunks.sol: “It is strange that you, of all people, knew nothing about it.”

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Feng stared silently at Mu Song, who could not continue.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng stared steadily at the speechless Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: “Do you know who moved first after the incident at Red Cliffs became known? The authorities? The Sea Serpent Society members who were lucky enough to survive? No. It was the Yangtze River Channel League. They invaded the Sea Serpent Society’s territory and took control of the Yangtze with astonishing speed.”
hunks.sol: “Do you know who moved first once word of the incident at Red Cliffs spread? The authorities? The Sea Serpent Society members who were lucky enough to survive? No. It was the Yangtze River Channel League. With remarkable speed, they moved into the Sea Serpent Society’s territory and seized control of the Yangtze.”

hunks.baseline: “……Great Hero Zhuge.”
hunks.sol: “…Great Hero Zhuge.”

hunks.baseline: Like the rest of us, he seemed to have finally realized why he had needed to remain there.
hunks.sol: Like the rest of us, he seemed to have finally realized why he had needed to remain.

hunks.baseline: “Of course I didn’t. The Great Hero Hwang of Donghu Stronghold whom I know is not such a foolish man. He is different from the other foolish and violent Stronghold Lords.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I didn’t. The Great Hero Hwang of Donghu Stronghold whom I know is not such a foolish man. He is different from the other foolish, violent Stronghold Lords.”

hunks.baseline: “That was certainly what I thought. Until the Dongting Fisherman, who had publicly condemned the Yangtze River Channel League, disappeared three days ago.”
hunks.sol: “That was certainly what I thought—until the Dongting Fisherman, who had publicly condemned the Yangtze River Channel League, disappeared three days ago.”
